en: The postcard features four sepia-toned photographs of ruins and landscapes. Three of the images depict the circular foundation and stone columns of the Tholos of Marmaria at Delphi, while the fourth image shows the scenic gorge of Delphi. The top right has text identifying the postcard as being from Continental Greece (Grèce Continentale), Delphi (Delphes). The images are labeled with reference numbers and French captions.
